rooms.title: Front exterior — two affordable paint directions
rooms.summary: A paint-first curb-appeal plan that keeps the roof, windows, masonry and structure while adding a calmer palette and simple planting.

alternatives.title: Nature-sage exterior variation
alternatives.summary: Light sage siding, creamy trim and a warm wood-look door create a softer garden-connected exterior.

rooms.title: Family hall — sofa, TV and living nature
rooms.summary: A welcoming family hall with mounted TV, washable seating, Islamic geometric art, layered light, plants and the home’s single aquarium.

alternatives.title: Screen-light family variation
alternatives.summary: More open floor play and lower storage, with the television visually secondary.

rooms.title: Second hall — prayer, reading and storage
rooms.summary: A naturally bright prayer room with separated rug zones, open circulation, compact seating and hidden storage.

alternatives.title: Open prayer and reading variation
alternatives.summary: A larger flexible floor area with movable chairs and a closed mat-storage bench.

rooms.title: Photo 13 — Amazon-style monstera and aquarium corner
rooms.summary: The existing monstera becomes the central canopy, with a compact planted aquarium and layered freestanding greenery while the stair opening, heater, curtains and maintenance route stay clear.

alternatives.title: Photo 13 — Oak Aquarium Nature Corner
alternatives.summary: Visual study only; verify floor capacity, heater clearance and electrical safety before installation.

alternatives.title: Photo 13 — Compact Paludarium Variation
alternatives.summary: Visual study only; verify floor capacity, heater clearance and electrical safety before installation.

alternatives.title: Photo 13 — Aquarium Detail Angle
alternatives.summary: Visual study only; verify floor capacity, heater clearance and electrical safety before installation.

alternatives.title: Photo 13 — Amazon Monstera Aquarium Wall
alternatives.summary: Amazon-style monstera and planted aquarium study; verify dimensions, floor support, stair clearance and electrical safety.

alternatives.title: Photo 13 — Compact Amazon Monstera Corner
alternatives.summary: Amazon-style monstera and planted aquarium study; verify dimensions, floor support, stair clearance and electrical safety.

rooms.title: Kitchen — remove the white refrigerator and add pantry cabinets
rooms.summary: Keep the stainless refrigerator and existing footprint; replace the extra white refrigerator with floor-to-ceiling pantry, drawers and an appliance garage.

alternatives.title: Sage and oak pantry variation
alternatives.summary: Repaint reusable lower cabinets sage and use a light-oak pantry wall for a warmer nature-focused kitchen.

rooms.title: Dining room — six seats, simple storage
rooms.summary: A durable six-seat dining setup with one closed cabinet and a clear route to the sliding door.

rooms.title: Breakfast and homework nook
rooms.summary: A compact everyday table for breakfast, homework and crafts, with hidden supplies and no extra lounge furniture.

rooms.title: Large bedroom — three individual storage beds
rooms.summary: Three movable twin beds with integrated drawers, nature details and an unobstructed closet route.

alternatives.title: Storage-first three-bed variation
alternatives.summary: No freestanding dresser; the beds provide nearly all clothing and toy storage.

alternatives.title: Three separate stackable twin beds
alternatives.summary: Four movable twin frames are bought as two pairs; use three now, keep one for a future room or guest, and add low rolling bins instead of a dresser.

alternatives.title: Three-child compact room — left doors clear
alternatives.summary: One convertible twin bunk plus one separate low twin keeps three permanent beds and preserves the bathroom/cabinet access and central play area.

alternatives.title: Four-child compact room — two convertible bunks
alternatives.summary: Two convertible twin bunks provide four permanent beds while leaving the bathroom/cabinet side open; verify windows, heaters and ladder clearances in person.

rooms.title: Medium bedroom — compact adult retreat
rooms.summary: A compact queen storage bed, narrow wall shelves, concealed clothing storage and a few raised plants.

rooms.title: Small upstairs bedroom — study only
rooms.summary: A two-place study room with a shallow desk, closed supplies, controlled cables and no bed.

rooms.title: Ground bedroom — four-screen creative office
rooms.summary: A focused digital studio with exactly four displays, sit-stand desk, ergonomic chair, cable management and plants.

alternatives.title: Lower-cost one-screen office
alternatives.summary: Start with the desk, chair and storage, then add displays only when work requires them.

rooms.title: Full bathroom — repair-first cosmetic refresh
rooms.summary: Keep plumbing locations and serviceable fixtures while improving storage, lighting, water efficiency and calm color.

rooms.title: Half bathroom — compact low-cost refresh
rooms.summary: Paint, lighting, faucet and compact storage give the small bath a finished look without expanding it.

rooms.title: Sunroom — aviary and family relaxation
rooms.summary: A divided flight enclosure gives cockatiels horizontal movement while retaining a calm, clean family sitting zone.

alternatives.title: Smaller breeding-suite variation
alternatives.summary: A compact enclosed bird room leaves more of the porch available for family seating.

alternatives.title: Relax-room-first variation
alternatives.summary: Use the porch as a family room until repairs, insulation and climate control are proven.

rooms.title: Rear deck — family dining, herbs and rain capture
rooms.summary: Clean and refinish the existing deck, then add compact dining, shade, herbs, efficient light and controlled rain capture.

rooms.title: Upper-lawn food garden — compact productive zone
rooms.summary: All food production uses the empty upper lawn around the marked 45.2% × 12.9% location; the side of the house and large family lawn remain clean and open.

alternatives.title: Earlier ground-level garden study
alternatives.summary: Retained for comparison; the compact aerial plan above is the selected direction.

alternatives.title: Whole-yard overhead planning view
alternatives.summary: Use this only for zoning ideas; verify the survey, dimensions, sunlight, utilities and setbacks.
